list_keyframes: list all keyframe timestamps from a video file using pyav container seeking
read_keyframes: read keyframe data from a video file given a list of keyframe timestamps
video_list_from_file: create a list of video file paths from a plain text file with optional base path
read_keyframe_helper_data: read keyframe helper data from a CSV file mapping video IDs to keyframe lists
VideoKeyframeDataset: build a PyTorch dataset that provides keyframes from a set of videos with optional transforms
